create_telemetry_logger: create a module-labelled telemetry logger using get_logger to send key-value pairs
set_telemetry_exporter: set a custom telemetry exporter function using set_exporter to replace the default no-op SEND
use_telemetry_sendfn_protocol: use the TelemetrySendFn protocol to define a callback that sends key-value telemetry data
handle_failed_telemetry_callback: handle FailedTelemetryCallbackError exceptions when a telemetry callback fails during execution
review_telemetry_module: review the telemetry module to understand the global SEND variable and late binding pattern
